notes: Each rule carries its own `confidence` and `citation`. The engine must surface confidence in output. Never present a `secondary_unverified` rule to a citizen as settled fact.

confidence_levels.sourced_official: Stated on an official government page or circular. Safe to act on.
confidence_levels.sourced_official_summary: On an official state page, but a summary page compiled by the Information & Cultural Affairs Dept, not the line department. Treat as reliable but re-verify before production.
confidence_levels.secondary_unverified: Reported consistently by aggregators/news but NOT confirmed on an official portal. Show to the operator as 'verify at the office'. Do not auto-reject a citizen on this rule.

legal_basis.ENGINE_WARNING: Today's date is before 2027-01-01, so a new sanction right now still falls under the 2017 Master Circular. The rules below are from the 2026 Directions. Store both and pick by sanction date — do not hardcode one.

eligibility_rules.operator_note_en: Allied activities expressly include dairy, poultry, small ruminants, fisheries/aquaculture, sericulture, beekeeping and lac. Tenants and sharecroppers are eligible in both the crop and allied branches.

eligibility_rules.operator_note_en: There is NO minimum landholding. Marginal = up to 1 ha, small = over 1 to 2 ha. Flexi KCC of Rs 10,000-50,000 is available to marginal farmers without relating it to the value of the land. Never turn away a small farmer for 'too little land'.
Scale of Finance (SoF) is set by the SLTC/DLTC. A crop with no notified SoF falls outside KCC entirely.
eligibility_rules.fail_message_en: This crop has no notified Scale of Finance, so it falls outside KCC.
eligibility_rules.fail_message_bn: এই ফসলের জন্য নির্ধারিত স্কেল অফ ফাইন্যান্স নেই, তাই KCC-র আওতার বাইরে।

document_alternatives.description: KCC land proof is an OR-chain with a conditional cap, not a single required document. This is the rule that lets a landless bargadar borrow.

satisfied_if_any.operator_note_en: Fallback where a PRI certificate is hard to obtain. Valid ONLY for loans up to Rs 50,000.

west_bengal_note.text: A bargadar recorded in the Record of Rights can show the khatian with the barga entry as the land record. An unrecorded bargadar falls back to the PRI certificate or the affidavit route.
west_bengal_note.operator_note_en: This mapping is Dishari's reading of para 29/30 against WB's barga recording practice, not a published RBI or WB instruction.

computed_values.escalation: Maximum Permissible Limit rises by a notional 10% each season. If SoF is not notified for a season, apply a 10% hike over the previous SoF.
computed_values.engine_note: Dishari should NOT quote a final sanctioned amount to a citizen. Show it as an indicative range and mark it provisional — the bank sets the actual limit.

collateral_rules.requirement: No collateral where there is crop hypothecation and a recovery tie-up

DISPUTED.evidence_for_3L: PIB Release 2106230 (Ministry of Finance, 25 Feb 2025) states Rs 3 lakh; a secondary report says the RBI circular of 13 Jan 2026 still uses Rs 3 lakh

cross_check_relevance: XC_NAME: THE hero case. KCC requires the land record, so a name mismatch between Aadhaar and the khatian blocks the application. Fix route: free minor correction of the Record of Rights at the BL&LRO or banglarbhumi.gov.in.

schemes.name_en: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB PM-JAY)
schemes.name_bn: আয়ুষ্মান ভারত প্রধানমন্ত্রী জন আরোগ্য যোজना
schemes.department: National Health Authority (NHA), Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, with the West Bengal State Health Agency
schemes.critical_architecture_note: DO NOT write computable eligibility rules for the main PM-JAY branch. Inclusion is not through registration; it is based on the SECC 2011 database. No combination of Aadhaar, ration card or income certificate can establish eligibility. Documents verify identity AGAINST the list; they do not create entitlement. Dishari's correct output here is `cannot_determine` plus a lookup action.

west_bengal_status.summary: West Bengal implemented PM-JAY in September 2018, withdrew on 10 January 2019 in favour of Swasthya Sathi, and rejoined in 2026 as the 36th and final State/UT.
west_bengal_status.operator_note_en: Sources disagree on whether benefits began 1 July or 16 August 2026. Do not quote a launch date to a citizen. The MoU date (8 June 2026) is the better-corroborated fact.

benefit.scope: Cashless, paperless secondary and tertiary hospitalisation at empanelled public and private hospitals

basis.rural: Families meeting at least one of six deprivation criteria (D1-D5 and D7), plus automatically included categories such as destitute/living on alms and manual scavenger households
basis.urban: Eleven occupational categories, including street vendors, cobblers, hawkers, construction workers, plumbers, masons, domestic workers, sweepers, sanitation workers, home-based artisans and transport workers

lookup_action.in_person: Arogya Mitra operator at an empanelled hospital searches the beneficiary list

eligibility_branches.operator_instruction_en: Run the lookup at beneficiary.nha.gov.in using the citizen's mobile or ration card number. Dishari cannot answer this from documents.

eligibility_branches.label_en: Senior citizen branch — age 70 and above

eligibility_rules.operator_note_en: The 70+ expansion applies irrespective of economic status, so no income or SECC test is needed on this branch. A senior already covered by another government health scheme may reportedly use PM-JAY additionally — verify before advising.

cross_document_checks.description: Fields that must agree across documents before submission. A mismatch here blocks the application regardless of eligibility.

fix_routes.aadhaar_is_outlier: Update name at an Aadhaar enrolment/update centre (UIDAI).
fix_routes.bank_is_outlier: Update KYC name at the bank branch.
fix_routes.epic_is_outlier: Form 8 correction with the Electoral Registration Officer.
fix_routes.land_record_is_outlier: Minor correction of Record of Rights — free, at the BL&LRO or banglarbhumi.gov.in.

checks.operator_note_en: No official West Bengal rule states which record to correct when they differ. These routes are Dishari's logic, not a published rule.
Madhyamik certificate DOB is usually treated as authoritative for age in education-linked schemes. Partial dates (year only) should be flagged as 'incomplete', not 'conflict'.
Address drift is common and rarely blocks on its own, but PIN/district mismatch can break the residence rule.
DBT fails without Aadhaar seeding. Dishari CANNOT verify NPCI seeding status from a passbook photo — flag for the operator to check separately.

operator_output_contract.description: What the engine must return per scheme, so the operator and the citizen summary can be generated.
operator_output_contract.rule: If any rule used is secondary_unverified, the verdict must be shown as provisional and the citizen summary must say 'verify at the office'.

determination_methods.computable: Every eligibility rule can be tested from fields extracted off the citizen's documents. Dishari can return a real verdict.
determination_methods.external_lookup: Eligibility is NOT computable from documents. It is decided by a pre-built government database. Dishari must return `cannot_determine` and hand the operator a lookup action. Its job here is document readiness and the lookup, never a verdict.
determination_methods.hybrid: Most of the scheme is external_lookup, but one branch is computable (e.g. an age-based universal entitlement).

demo_narrative.description: One family, one scan, two departments, one blocked claim saved.
steps: Farmer comes in for KCC. Dishari reads his Aadhaar, khatian and bank passbook.
AUDIT FIRES: the khatian name does not match Aadhaar. KCC requires the land record, so this is BLOCKING, not a warning.
FIX ROUTE: minor correction of the Record of Rights - free, at the BL&LRO or banglarbhumi.gov.in. Tell him what to bring.
WHOLE-FAMILY MATCH: his wife, 34, qualifies for Annapurna Yojana at Rs 3,000 a month. Nobody asked about it.
OPTIONAL CLOSER: his father is 71. PM-JAY returns cannot_determine with a lookup action, because the engine refuses to guess from documents.
